english_method: 英文参考步骤（笔记示范）：(1) Aggregate the chosen temperature series by calendar month and hold out the final twelve observations. (2) Fit all preprocessing and the fixed ARIMA specification using training data only, then forecast twelve months. (3) Forecast the same months with the training-period seasonal-naive benchmark. (4) Plot both forecasts against the same actual values, compute RMSE on the same temperature scale, and compare the errors and annual patterns.
